Body.Content:
Enable distribution businesses to maintain inventory costs and valuations independently in a parallel ledger, using that ledger’s own currency and costing method. This supports parallel inventory valuation alongside the existing primary-ledger costing configuration. The initial scope is focused on distribution scenarios.

GA date: November CY2027

Preview date: May CY2027
